title: Verify: Config and createGame pass zoom unit tests
summary: Phaser-mocked tests for zoom in config
description: Unit tests with Phaser mocked prove that zoom is put into the config and forwarded by createGame.
acceptance_criteria: Config zoom set and defaults to 1

steps.symbol: new: it('buildGameConfig sets scale.zoom and defaults to 1')
steps.action: Add a test calling buildGameConfig(document.createElement('div'), [], 3) and asserting scale.zoom is 3, then without the third argument asserting scale.zoom is 1. Follow the file's existing Phaser import or mock approach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts

steps.symbol: new: it('createGame forwards zoom to the Phaser.Game config')
steps.action: Use vi.mock('phaser') with a fake Game class capturing its config argument; call createGame(div, [], 2) and assert captured config.scale.zoom equals 2.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserConfig.test.ts -t 'forwards zoom'
